checks.question: Is the source the one that the site describes?
checks.note: The site build records the commit of this repository. The record of the Lean build records the commit of tamnd/singularity-lean and the pin of the base. The check that refuses a mismatch is planned.

checks.question: Does it build?
checks.note: The workflows build and base of tamnd/singularity-lean build the packages Singularity and SingularityBase at Lean v4.35.0 on GitHub runners, at commit 69685f3. The base job restores the build of resolutionorg/hironaka from a cache keyed by its pin and the toolchain.

checks.question: Which axioms do the top theorems use?
checks.note: 715 declarations in records/lean.json. Each uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The scan finds no sorry, admit or axiom in the project source.

checks.question: Does a second kernel accept it?
checks.note: The trust workflow of tamnd/singularity-lean has two parts. First, leanchecker --fresh replays the environments of Singularity and SingularityBase in the kernel of Lean. Second, lean4lean, a type checker for Lean written in Lean, checks each declaration of the package Singularity. Run 45271857389 at commit 665b516 accepted all of them: leanchecker took 658 s and 784 s, and lean4lean checked 211 declarations in 186 s. lean4lean takes the imports of each module as correct, so it does not check Mathlib or SingularityBase again. lean4lean follows the design of the C++ kernel, so it is a second implementation but not an independent design. The state stays open until a person decides if this is sufficient. A check with nanoda is not yet in the workflow.

checks.question: Do the proved theorems have the pinned statements?
checks.note: manifests/statements.sha256 pins the statement files, and CI checks the hashes. The comparator run against the pinned statements is not yet in the trust workflow.

checks.question: Do the statements mean what the docstrings say?
checks.note: Fidelity checks F2 (the identity of a regular scheme) and F3 (the codiagonal) are proved. The bridge to formal-conjectures is proved in one direction. The other instances of the battery are planned.

checks.question: Which published theorems are still hypotheses?
checks.note: None. The last one, ReductionToIntegral (SG0000001Y), is proved by Singularity.Reduction.reductionToIntegral. The theorems resolutionInDim_charZero (SG0000000D) and Curves.resolutionInDim_one (SG0000001A) use it and take no hypothesis.

checks.note: The handbook sections are at status drafted. No reviewer has signed them.
